To find the total cubic yards of concrete needed including 7% waste:

1. **Calculate the volume in cubic feet:**
   $$\text{Volume} = 187\text{ ft} \times \left(2 + \frac{7}{12}\right)\text{ ft} \times \left(1 + \frac{2}{12}\right)\text{ ft} = 187 \times 2.58333 \times 1.16667 \approx 563.355\text{ ft}^3$$

2. **Convert cubic feet to cubic yards:**
   $$\text{Volume in CY} = \frac{563.355}{27} \approx 20.865\text{ CY}$$

3. **Add 7% waste:**
   $$\text{Total with waste} = 20.865 \times 1.07 \approx 22.34\text{ CY}$$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
